description.en: The ID of the instance. You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~144595~~) operation to query the instance ID.

description.zh: 实例列表的页码，起始值为1，默认值为1。
description.en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.

description.zh: 每页最多可显示的行数，最大值为100，默认值为10。
description.en: The maximum number of entries per page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 10.

descriptions.zh: 已开通HBase增强版实例的备份恢复功能，具体请参见[开通备份恢复](~~145767~~)。
descriptions.en: The backup and restore feature of the HBase Enhanced Edition instance is enabled. For more information, see [Enable backup and restore](~~145767~~).
